biotools.summary: sciMET-cap is a software resource enabling high-throughput single-cell methylation analysis with a reduced sequencing burden by leveraging target enrichment. It enables cell type assignment and genome-wide differentially methylated region (DMR) calling with fewer sequencing reads.
